model.name: iAL1080 - Vreelandella boliviensis LC1 genome-scale metabolic model

html.p: HB_ENERGY_N_REPAIR_CANDIDATE_V1: conservative respiratory coupling repair for O2/N simulations; source model preserved separately.
HB_PHB_CURATION: Targeted PHB terminal module; four-monomer lumped polymer representation
Recommended final article cleanup: removed 20 blocked-reaction cleanup targets. Only metabolites/genes newly orphaned by these deletions were pruned; pre-existing orphan metabolites were preserved.

Final article V2 compact cleanup: removed 93 no-GPR exchange reactions that were default-blocked, currency-filtered-main-network disconnected, not linked to GPR-supported side components, and unable to support growth when individually tested as C/N/P/S nutrient substitutions. Repair-protected reactions and all GPR-supported reactions were retained.
Organism: Vreelandella boliviensis LC1; NCBI Taxonomy ID: 1072583.
pseudo_gene_policy: spontaneous is a non-biological reaction placeholder excluded from biological statistics
